notes.subject: bel bilong mi
notes.rationale: נפש em i breth/laip bilong man, i no 'soul' — Tok Pisin 'bel' i klostu long tingting-laik.

notes.subject: שלמה
notes.rationale: שַׁלָּמָה: 'bilong wanem' (lo, man i tanim ol i stret) o nem bilong 'olsem Shelomo' — KJV 'as one that turneth aside' i narapela rot.

notes.subject: tokim mi
notes.rationale: Olgeta kwesten bilong wanem ples — toktok i pulim man i rit i kamap insait.

translation: Tokim mi, yu — bel bilong mi inap long yu: we yu wok long givim kaikai long ol sipsip, we yu mekim ol i slip long bel bilong de? Bilong wanem bai mi kamap olsem wanpela i putim helap, namel long ol lain sipsip bilong ol poro bilong yu?

tokens.gloss: yu — bel bilong mi inap long yu
